deployment.notes: Client SDK for companion computers; not itself a learned model.

usage.training: SDK primitive for command/telemetry; autonomy logic is separate.
usage.needs_data: A compatible autopilot and a command/telemetry design.
usage.update_strategy: Follow upstream safety guidance; test in simulation and with failsafes.

evaluation: Command reliability, latency and failsafe behaviour on the target vehicle.
limitations: A control SDK is not a safety system; flight testing and governance are required.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of autopilot SDK scope and BSD-3-Clause licence; not a flight benchmark.

entries.name: PX4 Autopilot

usage.training: Deterministic autopilot foundation; learned modules can be layered on top.
usage.needs_data: Airframe configuration, sensors and calibration.
usage.update_strategy: Follow the upstream safety process; never fly unreviewed changes.

evaluation: Flight-test validation, failsafe behaviour and estimator health on the airframe.
limitations: Safety-critical; requires certification-grade processes beyond code inspection.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of autopilot scope, hardware targets and BSD-3-Clause licence; not a flight or board benchmark.

entries.name: robomimic

usage.training: Trains imitation/offline-RL policies from demonstrations.
usage.needs_data: Demonstration datasets and a task/evaluation protocol.
usage.update_strategy: Revalidate on the target robot; add safety supervision on actions.

evaluation: Task success and robustness under perturbation on held-out tasks.
limitations: Offline data coverage limits generalisation; real-robot safety must be enforced.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of robot-learning framework and MIT licence; not a hardware benchmark.

entries.name: Nav2

evaluation: Navigation success rate, safety stops and recovery behaviour on the robot.
limitations: A planning stack is not a learned model and needs safety supervision for real robots.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of navigation scope and Apache-2.0 licence; not a hardware benchmark.

entries.name: LeRobot

evaluation: Task success rate on the target robot plus safety-boundary behaviour.
limitations: Embodiment-specific; a policy trained on one robot may not transfer to another.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of robot-learning scope, datasets and Apache-2.0 licence; not a hardware benchmark.

entries.name: Octo

limitations: Generalist policies need adaptation and safety constraints for real hardware.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of policy scope, variants and MIT licence; not a hardware benchmark.

usage.needs_data: Pixel-labelled images for the target classes.
usage.update_strategy: Re-export and re-benchmark; verify per-encoder weight licences.

evaluation: mIoU on target data plus exported-model latency/memory.
limitations: Encoder weights inherit ImageNet dataset licensing and bias.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of segmentation model zoo and MIT licence; not a board benchmark.

entries.name: MegaDetector-Classifier
entries.description: Fine-tuning pipeline for adapting camera-trap species classifiers to local datasets.

deployment.notes: Training/adaptation toolkit that consumes detector crops.

usage.training: Fine-tunes species classifiers on region-specific labelled crops.
usage.needs_data: Labelled animal crops from the target region.
usage.update_strategy: Revalidate per region and season; track class coverage and imbalance.

evaluation: Top-1/top-k accuracy and calibration on region-matched held-out data.
limitations: Classification accuracy degrades outside the fine-tuning region.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of fine-tuning pipeline and MIT code licence; not a field benchmark.

entries.name: SpeciesNet
entries.description: Global camera-trap classifier covering thousands of species, designed to consume MegaDetector output.

deployment.notes: Upstream positions it as a downstream classifier to MegaDetector detections.

usage.training: Published classifier; fine-tuning for regional data is possible.
usage.needs_data: Animal crops from a detector plus labels for evaluation.
usage.update_strategy: Verify licence and revalidate accuracy on the target region before deployment.

evaluation: Top-1/top-k accuracy and calibration on a region-matched validation set.
limitations: Code licence is Apache-2.0; weight terms are unknown.

evidence.notes: Referenced by the MegaDetector documentation as a compatible global species classifier; not a board benchmark.

entries.name: LightStereo (OpenStereo)
entries.description: Efficient stereo matching for disparity estimation.

deployment.notes: Upstream target classes, not hardware results reproduced by this catalogue.

io.camera_setup: two calibrated and synchronized RGB cameras
io.coordinate_system: disparity; metric depth requires calibration and known baseline

entries.notes: OpenStereo explicitly prohibits commercial use of its code. Choose a LightStereo checkpoint, not an arbitrary model in the zoo. Stereo inference alone is not scene fusion.

entries.name: CosmoEdge
entries.description: C++ edge video-analytics engine targeting Rockchip RKNN, Sophon and RV1126B-class accelerators.

deployment.notes: Upstream names RKNN, Sophon, BM1688 and RV1126B targets; per-board validation is separate.

usage.training: Runtime/pipeline for video analytics; models are supplied separately.
usage.needs_data: Target board, converted models and configured pipelines.
usage.update_strategy: Pin engine and model revisions; re-benchmark on each specific board.

evaluation: End-to-end throughput and accuracy on the named board and sensor set.
limitations: Code licence is Apache-2.0; naming a target chip is not reproduced compatibility.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of target accelerators and pipeline scope; not a board benchmark.

entries.name: Anomalib
entries.description: OpenVINO-adjacent library of visual anomaly-detection algorithms with deployment and export.

deployment.notes: Supports export/optimization for edge deployment via OpenVINO.

usage.training: Trains anomaly detectors, often on normal-only data.
usage.needs_data: Representative normal images and a labelled anomaly test set.
usage.update_strategy: Retrain when the process/product changes; monitor drift continuously.

evaluation: Image-level and pixel-level AUROC on held-out anomalies plus latency.
limitations: Normal-only training can miss novel defect types; threshold choice is critical.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of algorithms, export and Apache-2.0 licence; not a board benchmark.

entries.name: MegaDetector V6
entries.description: Camera-trap detector for animals, people and vehicles, with compact edge-oriented variants.

model.measurement_scope: Compact YOLOv10 variant; other variants range from about 9.7M to 76M parameters.

license.weights: MIT, Apache-2.0 or AGPL-3.0 per variant

deployment.notes: Upstream states compact variants run on CPU and power the solar SPARROW field unit.

usage.training: Released weights plus a fine-tuning pipeline for local datasets.
usage.needs_data: Camera-trap images; labelled crops for fine-tuning or evaluation.
usage.update_strategy: Check the licence of the exact variant before deployment and re-measure per target.

evaluation: Animal recall, mAP and throughput on representative field imagery and target hardware.
limitations: Detects animal/person/vehicle, not species; small or camouflaged animals are harder.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of variant sizes, licences and edge claims; not a board benchmark.

entries.name: PyTorch-Wildlife
entries.description: Conservation deep-learning framework and model zoo hosting MegaDetector and species classifiers.

deployment.notes: CPU inference is supported; optional CUDA gives large speedups.

usage.training: Framework plus fine-tuning recipes for detection and classification.
usage.needs_data: Camera-trap imagery; labelled data for adaptation.
usage.update_strategy: Pin framework and model versions; revalidate detection/classification metrics per dataset.

evaluation: Detection and species metrics on the deployment region plus inference cost.
limitations: Species classifiers are region-specific; performance drops outside their training domain.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of framework scope and hosted models; not a board benchmark.

entries.name: GraphCast
entries.description: DeepMind graph neural network that produces medium-range global weather forecasts.

deployment.notes: Accelerator-oriented; operational use needs large memory and full atmospheric state inputs.

usage.training: Pretrained weights plus training code from ERA5-style data.
usage.needs_data: Full-resolution atmospheric state and boundary inputs; verification data.
usage.update_strategy: Pin model version; verify against operational baselines before any reliance.

evaluation: Skill scores versus operational numerical weather prediction baselines.
limitations: Not a small-device model; weights licence and operational reliability must be verified.

evidence.notes: Documentation review of graph weather model scope and Apache-2.0 code licence; not an operational benchmark.
